title: DetM-Tracker: Deterministic and Memory-Efficient VIS for Autonomous Industrial Inspection

problem.summary: Autonomous industrial inspection requires strictly deterministic real-time inference under tight memory and computational constraints.
statements: Autonomous industrial inspection requires strictly deterministic real-time inference under tight memory and computational constraints.

However, existing Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) models suffer from prohibitive scaling: dense temporal memory grows with spatial resolution and sequence length, while fixed-capacity decoders fail to exploit the inherent sparsity of industrial scenes, creating a practical memory wall on resource-constrained edge platforms.
We present DetM-Tracker, a streamlined VIS framework for autonomous industrial inspection, where target objects often exhibit highly similar appearance under constrained "micro" fields of view.
